            WHEN f.com_res = 'Adequate' THEN 2
            WHEN f.com_res = 'Limited' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS resource_score,
        COUNT(tout.tx_out_key) AS total_outcomes,

    FROM facilities f
    JOIN clinicians c ON c.fac_connect = f.fac_key

),
